patch_description: The current seed (RY+RZ+CZ-ring+RZ) underperforms (0.85) compared to the best prior program (0.89) which used modular RY/RX rotation layers combined with ring, skip-2, skip-3, and diameter CRZ entanglers repeated across two blocks with shared parameters. I restore that stronger modular architecture and additionally insert a single-parameter "star" CRZ layer (hub qubit 0 connected via CRZ to every other qubit) after the diameter layer in each block. This hub-and-spoke entangler adds global connectivity complementary to the ring/skip/diameter distances at the cost of only one extra shared parameter, which prior evidence suggests strengthens generalization without much added depth or parameter overhead. Reusing the same "crz_star" parameter across both block copies keeps parameter count low while doubling the depth of this new global-mixing layer.
